blocks.tamil_translation: he will be adorned with ornaments up to whatever part the water of Wudu reaches), Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that he heard his beloved, the Prophet ﷺ, say.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ أُمَّتِي يُدْعَوْنَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ غُرّاً مُّحَجَّلِينَ مِنْ آثَارِ الْوُضُوءِ، فَمَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يُطِيلَ غُرَّتَهُ فَلْيَفْعَلْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب فضل الوضوء والغرالمحجلون...رقم: ١٣٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that he heard the Messenger of Allah ﷺ say, “On the Day of Qiyamah, my Ummah will be called while the limbs of Wudu, namely the hands, feet and face, are shining and radiant because of making Wudu abundantly. Whoever wishes to increase his radiance, let him increase it.”

blocks.text:
Explanation:- That is, one should make Wudu carefully so that no part of the limbs of Wudu is left out.
(Mazahir-e-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ عَفَّانَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ خَرَجَتْ خَطَايَاهُ مِنْ جَسَدِهِ حَتَّي تَخْرُجَ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَظْفَارِهِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Uthman ibn Affan (RA) has narrated that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever makes Wudu in a beautiful manner, observing its Sunnahs, etiquette and Mustahabs, his sins begin to leave his body and go out from beneath his nails.”

blocks.text: Explanation:- Through acts of worship such as Wudu and Salah, only minor sins
